name: NaviMusic
description: A Discord music bot that plays YouTube and Spotify tracks and playlists in voice channels.

services.name: navi-music
entrypoint: java $JAVA_OPTS -jar /app/NaviMusic.jar nogui --spring.profiles.active=prod; code=$?; if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then echo "NaviMusic is idle. Set DISCORD_TOKEN (and optionally Spotify/YouTube credentials) in the Environment tab, then redeploy."; tail -f /dev/null; fi; exit $code
